messages:
ana (infosec): FYI: New egress baseline for eu-central scheduled Sat 02:00 UTC. It will enforce deny-by-default for non-approved CIDRs and may block our legacy pool bootstrap path.

lucy (platform): Do we have a list of which bootstrap flows rely on the old CIDRs? Need to know if GPU onboarding will be impacted.

tom (infra): Quick scan: nodes call `keystore.eu.redwood` and `node-bootstrap-legacy.redwood` + telemetry to 54.21.99.0/24. Staging repro: `keystore handshake failed` and warm-pool nodes stalled.

diego (sre): Metrics from staging: warm-pool fill fell from 78% to 36% after the rule applied. We saw increased auth cache hits and longer cold-start tails.

ana (infosec): (typo) ana: Compliance will allow a scoped temporary exception if we provide the exact FQDNs, justification, and a 24-48h expiry. They also want extended audit retention for those flows.

lucy (platform): I'll open an ACL PR to the fw repo with specific FQDNs and request 24h window. PR link: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1257

tom (infra): Plan: canary the exception per AZ and add a smoke test: `curl -sS https://keystore.eu.redwood/health` from new node. Also add alert if `gpu_warmpool_fill` drops >15% in 10m.

diego (sre): Rollback criteria agreed. ops-bot, create ticket and attach PR.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-412 "Scoped egress exception (eu-central) for GPU onboarding" assigned to ana, lucy.

ana (infosec): ana: Approved for 24h with audit retention + post-mortem required. Remove exception ASAP and fix proxy routing in next sprint.

lucy (platform): Merging PR and starting AZ canary now. Will post progress updates.

tom (infra): Starting backfills in 20m once PR deploys. Monitoring hooks in place.

diego (sre): I'll watch the channel and post short metric updates. Ping for any keystore 5xx >1% sustained 5m.
